title: The Echo Chamber of Modern Art: Originality Lost in Fan Hype?

commenti.body:
mainstream movie production has always had a degree of fan service to it. to me honestly it seems like lately there is a trend of them not even doing that either (im looking at you, marvel). part of this is due to the decline of home video, which pushes studios towards making films that can turn a profit just from the box office. as a result, big budget film productions have been completely taken over by their marketing departments in an attempt to get as many people to see the film on release, rather than on making a good film. no reason to make a film people will buy when people arent buying movies anymore. an oppenheimer sized chunk of the barbenheimer sized budget for *The Marvels* went towards marketing, which then ended up being a complete waste because ot marvel's cluttered release schedule. 

that being said, there are many good, artistic films being made these days. but they have comparatively low budgets and dont get such wide theatrical releases. and because they arent marketed as much, youre less likely to know about them.
